AppAccess.// GroupId: Deployed Dev reads the DEV access group. Active — the app-origination-dev-eus managed identity has the scoped-group read + User.ReadBasic.All grant (2026-07-28), so usage-dashboard filtering is live here.

Ctrm.// Source: Deployed Dev opts IN so the producer screen's contracts and tickets are read from CTRM for testing. Set to 'ods' (or empty) to fall straight back to the ODS views with no code change — the switch re-reads config per call, so an App Service setting override takes effect without a redeploy.
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: QA gateway, not apidev — QA is the environment the API was validated against and the client secret is a shared nonprod credential. Reachable per developer-docs/NETWORK-DIAGRAM.md: APIM traffic needs NO custom NSG outbound rule because the APIM private endpoint IPs are already allowed.
Ctrm.// ClientSecret: NOT set here and never should be. Supplied from kv-orig-dev-eus as secret 'Ctrm--ClientSecret' (Key Vault maps '--' to ':'), read by the App Service managed identity — the same path every other secret in this environment uses.
Ctrm.// ContractDateFrom: Contract-DATE window. 8,827 contracts = 18 pages, ~80s of background warm-up at PageConcurrency 4, retaining ~4,320 after non-purchase and unknown-producer rows are discarded. Widening is a cost dial, not a correctness fix: 2025-01-01 is 221 pages and 2024-01-01 is 341.
Ctrm.// SnapshotMinutes: 12 hours. The walk takes ~80s, so a short TTL risks a tester's request landing mid-rebuild. Restart the App Service to force a refresh.
Ctrm.// TicketBlDateFrom: Bill-of-lading window, SEPARATE from the contract window because the API rejects a BL range wider than 366 days. Calendar 2026 is 1,407 tickets / 3 pages / ~15s. Reaching into 2025 is not viable — Nov-Dec 2025 alone is 81,964 tickets (164 pages). Consequence to brief testers on: a contract dated Nov-Dec 2025 will show an empty applied-tickets list because its tickets fall outside this window.
